matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the same mathematical inconsistency in Section 3.2.1's density compensation formula. It correctly observes that multiplying by √ρ(v_j) amplifies rather than reduces similarity for high-density regions, directly contradicting the stated goal. This matches the ground truth defect despite describing it from the opposite polarity (the verifier saw the corrupted version where multiplication occurs, while the original had division).

Finding 2 identifies a different defect in the hypersphere formulation (incorrect constraint form in Eq. 4), not the contradiction about whether boundary features are noisy vs. informative. The ground truth concerns the semantic interpretation of boundary features, while Finding 2 concerns the mathematical validity of the sphere constraint itself.
